answers.working: Sum male+female per option band: 0-4=7.1+6.7=13.8; 15-19=6.0+5.6=11.6; 30-34=3.6+3.2=6.8; 60-64=0.8+0.9=1.7. Highest is 0-4 at 13.8%, clearly ahead of the next-highest option (15-19 at 11.6).

Combined (M+F) 0-4 = 2.0+1.8=3.8%, the smallest of any band (peak is 45-49 at 4.4+4.2=8.6%). A narrow base with a bulge in working/older-working age and no corresponding cohort coming up behind it means births are running below the level needed to replace the population, so once the large middle-aged cohort dies off, deaths will exceed births -> population decline. Options 1 and 3 contradict a narrow base; option 2 is not supported by a continuing narrowing trend.

No numeric stimulus given for this question, only a text description. 'Relatively even bar lengths from 0 to 60' describes roughly parallel/uniform bar widths across most of the age range, which is the defining feature of a column/barrel pyramid (typical of a HIC with low birth and death rates); a slight bulge at 50-60 is consistent with a historical baby-boom cohort ageing through the pyramid. A true diamond shape requires a distinctly narrower base than the mid-life bulge, which contradicts 'relatively even ... from age 0 to 60', so diamond is a weaker fit than column/barrel.
answers.concerns: No chart data was supplied for this question (description only), and 'column/barrel' vs 'diamond' terminology can overlap depending on how a given exam board's textbook illustrates ageing HIC pyramids. I judge column/barrel the better fit given the explicit 'relatively even 0-60' wording, but diamond is not unreasonable if a source elsewhere in the course defines diamond loosely as 'HIC with a mid-life bulge'.

answers.working: 0-4 combined = 7.1+6.7=13.8% (widest band), 75+ combined = 0.1+0.2=0.3% (narrowest band), with a steady taper in between (e.g. 30-34 combined = 3.6+3.2=6.8%, 60-64 combined = 0.8+0.9=1.7%). Wide base + narrow top = high birth rate, high death rate/lower life expectancy, the classic triangular LIC pyramid shape.

Working-age % = 100-42-4=54%. Dependency ratio = (dependents/working age) x100 = (42+4)/54 x100 = 46/54 x100 = 85.19 -> 85 (nearest whole number). The 60 million total population figure is not needed for the ratio since it is computed purely from the percentages (it would only matter if the question asked for absolute numbers of dependents/workers).
